snippet.title: Inked: A Tale of Love (2021) - Official Launch Trailer - Steam | Nintendo Switch
snippet.description:
Inked: A Tale of Love
Now available for download on Steam and Nintendo Switch
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/690120/Inked_A_Tale_of_Love/
Nintendo Switch: https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/inked-a-tale-of-love-switch/

Also available on the App Store and Google Play
App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/inked/i...
Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/de...

Game Introduction:
Inked is a tale of love and hope told in ink and paper. In this story-driven puzzle game, the players will play as the Nameless Hero who sets out on a journey to save his loved one in a vast and beautiful landscape filled with challenges. Each puzzle takes the player closer to their lost love and unravels a heart-warming and enchanting story.
